name: garmin-lite-mode
profile: 96 KiB watch tier (instinct2, instinct2s, instinct2x, instinctcrossover, descentg1)

request_sync.rule: The value ends with the suffix -lite. No new key is added because released phone parsers reject unknown request_sync keys.

sync_ack.rule: Additive integer key present on every sync_ack sent by a lite watch. Released receivers ignore unknown keys.

sync.phoneBehavior: A phone that sees the -lite suffix sends a binding-only sync: the existing sync message with empty planNames, planWeights and planReps and without exercises.
sync.releasedPhoneBehavior: Released phones keep sending their full plan. The watch accepts that message and drops the plan columns and the catalog immediately.
sync.watchBehavior: The watch applies the pairing fields (bindingVersion, syncId, requestId, accountBinding, deviceBinding, pairingGeneration, syncRevision, resetWorkout, repairPairing) and language with the same validation, replay, revision, ownership and account-transition checks as every other profile. planNames, planWeights, planReps and exercises are replaced by empty values before validation and are never copied or stored.
sync.planState: The watch holds no plan. A plan stored by an older build is deleted once at startup (marker lite96PurgedV1), but only while no active, prepared or queued workout depends on the exercise catalog.

response.applied: true when the sync was applied or is an exact replay of an applied revision; false when it was refused (bad binding, stale revision, workout in progress, save failure)
response.sentOnlyWhen: the message passes the correlation and binding checks, as on every other profile

ackAcceptance.android: Accepts the acknowledgement when type, syncId, requestId, syncRevision and applied=true match; other keys are ignored.
ackAcceptance.ios: Accepts the acknowledgement when bindingVersion, ids, revision, accountBinding, deviceBinding, pairingGeneration and applied=true match; other keys are ignored.

freeWorkout.message: create_workout with workoutMode=free, sets=[], durationSeconds, gymCalories and optional heart-rate keys; no plannedSetCount, plannedTargetSetCount, completedPlannedSetCount, setMetrics or setIntervals.
freeWorkout.queue: Up to 3 finished workouts stay queued on the watch and are sent one at a time; each is removed on its own ack.
freeWorkout.phoneBehavior: Android and iOS create an activity-only workout with the received duration.

rules: Phones that recognize the lite marker must not send plan arrays to that watch.
A lite watch records free workouts only; a plan is never shown or started on it.
Free workouts recorded on a lite watch upload through the existing create_workout and workout_part contracts unchanged.
Non-lite watches never send the marker and keep the full plan sync behavior.
